module: Master Spline tool of the World Editor ("masterSpline" edit mode). A Master Spline is a master curve (nodes, widths, normals) that drives a stack of layers, each linked to a child spline of another tool (mesh, assembly, decal, road, tree) offset laterally. The file mostly contains the imgui interface ("masterSpline" window, turn handles, gizmo, terraforming, auto road, homologation, session); the data lives in masterSpline/splineMgr.lua. It is meant for level creators, not for vehicles.
notes: The public API is small: two selection setters and the serialization/editor hooks; almost everything else is local to the file.
onEditorGui rebuilds the dirty Master Splines every frame even if the tool is not active (it then only draws the outlines via rSpline.renderShells).

onSerialize is destructive: after serializing, it unlinks all the splines, deletes all the Master Splines then calls be:reloadCollision() (the collision is baked into the scene). The data must therefore be reloaded by onDeserialized.
Auto road defaults: baseWidth 10, slopeAvoidance 1, bankingStrength 0.35, widthBlend 0.5. Lateral position slider between -5 and 5, DOI between 0 and 500.
The file registers with splineInput.registerSplineTool and declares a session spec (Save/Load Session) grouping masters and linked children.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before this one to guarantee the serialization order: editor_assemblySpline, editor_decalSpline, editor_meshSpline, editor_roadSpline, editor_treeSpline.

setSelectedSplineIdx.desc: Sets the index of the selected Master Spline (cross-selection between tools).

setSelectedNodeIdx.desc: Sets the index of the selected node (cross-selection between tools).

onSerialize.desc: Editor serialization hook: serializes all the Master Splines, unlinks their children, deletes the Master Splines and reloads the collision.

returns.desc: Array of the serialized Master Splines.

onDeserialized.desc: Deserialization hook: deletes the existing Master Splines, recreates those from data, then recomputes the id-to-index table.

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every editor frame: live optimization of the selected spline, rebuilding of dirty splines, then, if the tool is active, window, pan camera, engineered turn handles, mouse/keyboard events, terraforming and drawing.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Editor initialization hook: registers the "Master Spline" edit mode (editor.editModes.masterSpline) and the "masterSpline" window.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called when leaving the map: unlinks and deletes all the Master Splines and recomputes the id-to-index table.
